items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 71:1
items.html: After AA and Atik became a single Partzuf, and the NHY of AA rose to the place of the NHY of Atik, meaning to the place where AVI stand, AVI are now found in the phase of below the Chazeh of AA, which rose to the Peh of his Rosh, where the Hassadim are revealed. And this is the rule in every place where NHY rise to HGT: HGT gain the phase of the revealed Hassadim of NHY. And see in Pri Etz Chaim, in the Introduction to the Gate of Shabbat, Chapter 5. (Item 920, item 89)
